facts.fact: 开头：Jordan 抵达深夜嘉年华，环顾四周后觉得要在人群中找 Lily 简直遥遥无期。
facts.anchor: When Jordan finally arrived at the after-dark carnival, she took one look around and realized it would take FOREVER to find Lily

facts.fact: 中段：Jordan 仔细扫视全场，寻找金棕色头发、天真面孔或 Lily 的金属丝边眼镜等特征。
facts.anchor: Slowly, Jordan canvassed the area, keeping her eye out for any signs of golden brown hair, an innocent face, or Lily’s wire-rimmed glasses.

facts.fact: 困惑：Jordan 怀疑父亲做了什么让全家被发配到温哥华，以及 Nan 如何卷入其中。
facts.anchor: What had her dad done to get them shipped off to Vancouver? And how was Nan involved?

facts.fact: 转折：Lily 身边出现的男孩走近后，Jordan 认出他正是几小时前递给她那封信的人。
facts.anchor: The boy followed Lily’s lead, and as he got closer, Jordan realized she’d already met him.

facts.fact: 中段：Milo 转述 Kurt 的邀请，去 Thrill Harbor 一处地图外的隐秘地点探查。
facts.anchor: he’s about to check out this part of Thrill Harbor that’s off the map and he invited me to go along

facts.fact: 关键地点：Kurt 说那处有在建项目，其中一个叫 Plunge，是从巨大海岸悬崖纵身跳下的自由落体。
facts.anchor: One of them is called the Plunge. It’s a free-fall, right off an enormous coastal cliff.

facts.fact: 数字：Kurt 称 Plunge 落差达五百英尺，为世界之最。
facts.anchor: I heard that it was five hundred feet, the biggest in the world.

facts.fact: 结尾：Jordan 刚把陷在泥里的手电筒抠出来，就看见 Lily 头也不回地拔腿跑开。
facts.anchor: Just in time for Jordan to see Lily breaking into a run without looking back.
